subject: Confession: I built this at 2AM
preview_text: I don't usually write emails like this, but I need to tell you something about the app you downloaded.
body_paragraphs: I don't usually write emails like this, but I need to tell you something real. A few weeks ago, I was stuck in my own meeting chaos—scribbling notes, losing key points, and waking up at 2AM wondering what I agreed to. That night, I built the first version of Smart Notes. It wasn't pretty, but it worked. And I realized: you're probably dealing with the same mess.

Here's the thing—most people never open their notes after a call. They forget action items, miss follow-ups, and waste hours re-listening to recordings. But the ones who use our one-tap recording and get a structured summary with key points and action items? They leave every meeting with clarity, not chaos. That's not a feature—it's a lifeline.

You already have the app. And I want you to try something: next meeting, just tap 'Record' and let it do the work. The AI transcription turns audio into searchable text, and the summary highlights exactly what you need to act on. No rewriting. No guessing. Just your next steps, clear and ready.

Open Smart Notes now and start your first meeting summary. You'll wonder how you survived without it. P.S. — Users who create their first summary on day one are 3x more likely to stick with it. Don't let this sit on your phone.
